reason: A DSH plugin for monitoring OpenCode GO quota usage through a sidebar widget and the /opencode-go chat command, using an authenticated usage API proxy.

summaries.zh: 通过侧边栏组件和 /opencode-go 聊天命令显示 OpenCode GO 的滚动、每周和每月配额使用情况。
summaries.en: Displays OpenCode GO rolling, weekly, and monthly quota usage through a sidebar widget and the /opencode-go chat command.

capabilities: Reads an OpenCode GO API credential through DSH credentials
Makes authenticated outbound requests to the OpenCode GO usage API
Displays rolling, weekly, and monthly quota usage in a sidebar widget and chat command
Provides a same-origin HTTP proxy route for usage data
